meta.title: Brahma Kumaris Daily Thoughts
meta.description: Daily 'Thought for Today' reflections, transcribed verbatim from shivbabas.org English JPG images. Build in progress toward one year.
meta.status: partial — June 1-30 (except June 13, image not published), July 1-31, August 1-31 (except August 30, image not published), September 1-17; thoughts that refer to God are excluded
meta.fidelity: verbatim (text stored exactly as printed, including original capitalisation and punctuation)
meta.id_scheme: First 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over the text normalised to lowercase with collapsed whitespace. Stable, deterministic; reference a thought by its id.

thoughts.text: An honest man never fears the eyes of strangers.
If you follows the eternal law, you can understand how to love.
When you burn with the fire of anger, smoke gets into your eyes.
If you want to advance in life, make sure that your WANTS don’t advance.
Why try to prove yourself? Let others learn sense through your innocence.
If I cling to the past, the present becomes difficult and the future seems impossible.
Some people never mature because of a fear aging, and some because they refuse to accept responsibility.
If your mind is caught in bondages and problem of the past, you will not experience the joys of the present.
To tolerate someone else’s mistakes is one thing. To forgive them is even greater.
The quality of our Throughts determines our own personal degree of Happiness.
If you have the habit of minding other people’s business your own business will become bankrupt.
Love is Universal. It has no limits.
Only when you accept the rules of freedom can you call yourself free.
True victory means complete control over the sense-organs.
The greatest service is to share with others the joys of living.
The more you look for defects in others, the more you will become affected. Weaknesses are contagious.
What separates a highly developed man from an animal? His throughts.
Even through you cannot change time, Realise it is time for you to change.
If i enjoy praise, it means I can be easily hurt by defamation.
The one who is honest and has a true heart will always feel light and tension-free.
The only definite thing about human beings is that they change.
If a person hides his feelings, is it because there is something wrong with his feeling?
Once you get used to doing nothing, you find that there is no time left to become busy.
Everyone need company. Do I have enough love to share my company with someone?
Silence is not only the absence of sound but also stillness of the mind.
The fool wants others to see him; the wise man smiles at the audience.
If you care only for yourself, others will begin to care less for you.
A good, clean minded person sees the good points of others. A dirty minded person is always looking for dirt.
To UNDERSTAND something, you need knowledge, but to FEEL it, you nedd experience.
it is the hour of trial that makes men great, not the hour of triumph.
If I avoid someone because of the colour of his skin, it is the same as hating a man because of the clothes he wears.
Physical beauty can be lost with marks of age or through accident. Spiritual beauty cannot be destroyed.
If you are very proud of yourself, very quickly you will reach the stage in which you despise others.
If someone has a special talent and uses it for evil, it will change into a handicap.
Sometimes we force others to change beacause we want them to be how we want them to be.
The beauty of all things lies in your ability to appreciate them.
The unbelieving man can have no peace, and how can there be happiness for one who lacks peace of mind.
A person is pronounced great when he can face a difficult situation with Happiness and Laughter.
Sometimes due to jealousy we try to degrade others, and in so doing we degrade ourselves.
We explore the stars and the depths of the sea but how much do we know about ourselves and the reason for being here?
If I have an intense fear of darkness, it doesn’t makes sense in closing my eyes.
The more LOVE you give, the more you receive; the more you have, the easier it becomes to give.
If man cannot find peace within himself, can there be peace in this world?
In the world of constant sorrow, what brings greater wealth- money or Happiness?
To laugh at someone else’s misfortune is to display your own ignorance.
If you put a hood over eyes, you will not see anything. The worst hood is falsehood.
If a task is performed with the feeling of love, then there is instant success.
To end of birth is death. To end of death is birth.
The wealth of a rich man can be stolen or burnt, but the happiness and wisdom of the wise remain.
When there is the descent of man, What can be called decent?
Try to conquer greed NOW because “While man becomes old, his greed become youthful”.
Unless I develop Self-respect, I will remain under someone else’s foot.
If I make THIS MOMENT happy, it will increase my chances of having the next moment happy also.
Loneliness is often the result of one’s lack of ability to communicate.
It is greater to give a handful of rice with love and honesty than to give a thousand dollars with the desire for name and fame.
Before you point your finger of criticism at anyone else, see how much dirt you have under your finger-nail.
When there is growth, changes are automatic. If I fear change, how can there be growth?
Is it possible to have unity in a nation when each one feels that he is better than his neighbour?
If wealth is lost, nothing is lost; if health is lost; something is lost; if character is lost; everything is lost.
You must enjoy yourself and have recreation, but check wheather it enriches your life internally.
The princes among us are those who forget themselves and serve mankind.
Time is Life. Wasting time is wasting one’s life.
If I rely on too many people, I increase my chances of being disappointed.
No matter how bad a person may be, he must be prossessing at least one virtue. Be like the humming bird and pick the sweetness of virtues.
Be the Magnet of Peace so that you can attract peaceless souls.
Sometimes a Smile can be like a drop of water in a desert.
If we get involved in fears about the future, we shall miss the chances that the present offers us.
Good, clean competition is healthy but jealousy is a fatal illness.
No matter how hard I worry about a problem, Will my worried mind reach a solution?
What I experience now is a result of the past; What I experience in the future depends on what I do NOW.
We all consider ourselves to be part of MANKIND... Yes, we ARE part of MAN, but how KIND are we?
A simple way to remove fear is to seek knowledge and understanding.
Many people may want to quarrel and fight with you; Realise that the only weapons you need are a Smile and a Loveful attitude.
Even if you are sick and become a patient, you must never lose patience.
If a society loses its moral values, it loses everything.
Success springs from calmness of the mind. It is cold iron which cuts and bends hot iron.
To have balance in all situations is the key to Happiness.
What causes the most pain - the mistake or the criticism for the mistake?
Do not just be concerned about your rights, but consider whether or not you are right.
Problems in the world will increase; therefore, I should increase my capacity for dealing with problems.
The giving of love and mercy to others is also a form of charity.
If a man is unable to wipe out his own tendency to anger, how can he criticize anyone for the lack of ability in controlling themselves?
When you smile, not only do you feel Happy but you bring a Ray of Light into the lives of others.
If clouds remain in the mind, water will fall from the eyes.
The experience of True Happiness cures the sickness of sorrow.
We all must face problems, but it is how you face them that counts.
The worried convict dies many times before he reaches the gallows.
The more you enjoy putting in good efforts, the greater will be your happiness of receiving the fruits of those efforts.
